_about: Labels verify/derive.js gives today that are wrong, for the labels builder (branch wt-labels: derive.js the only source of labels, no hand overrides). Found by the review of the Adeptus Custodes catalogue (verify/review/result-catalog-custodes.json). data.js keeps derive.js's values until derive.js gets the general rule; the catalogue writer has no exception of its own (verify/catalog-write.js). resolved: items derive.js on main now gives right (no hand label); items: what is still wrong, with the Chaos Daemons catalogue's (verify/from-bsdata.js chaos-daemons).

items.why: TARGET: "One SYNAPSE unit from your army … and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit": the second SYNAPSE names the same unit again; needs list it twice under any.
items.rule: a keyword named again in the TARGET ("… of the SYNAPSE unit") is the same unit, not an alternative: no duplicate, all
items.source: data.js FACTIONS tyranids (a catalogue detachment, verify/from-bsdata.js tyranids), Wahapedia tyranids

items.where: Tyranids · Vanguard Onslaught rule · Questing Tendrils
items.why: "… are eligible to charge in a turn in which they Fell Back / Advanced": the rule is used when the unit declares a charge (the Charge phase); the Fall Back and Advance are what it allows, not when it is used.
items.rule: "eligible to charge in a turn in which they …" is used in the Charge phase (the moves it names are its condition)
items.source: data.js FACTIONS tyranids (a catalogue detachment, verify/from-bsdata.js tyranids), Wahapedia tyranids

items.where: Tyranids · Subterranean Assault rule · Surprise Assault
items.why: "Each time a TYRANIDS model from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1." reaches every TYRANIDS unit; the later bullets (BURROWER units, MAWLOC/TRYGON) are parts of the same rule for some of them, not alternatives to TYRANIDS.
items.rule: the rule's first unit keyword with "from your army" decides needs; later bullets naming narrower keywords are parts, not an any
items.source: data.js FACTIONS tyranids (a catalogue detachment, verify/from-bsdata.js tyranids), Wahapedia tyranids

items.where: Chaos Daemons · Legion of Excess · Archagonists
items.why: TARGET: "One LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH MONSTER unit or up to two LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH units (excluding MONSTERS)": two alternatives, MONSTER in one and excluded in the other; needs puts both in all/none, which no unit meets.
items.rule: a TARGET of "A unit or up to two B units (excluding A)" needs only what both alternatives share
items.source: data.js FACTIONS chaos-daemons (a catalogue detachment, verify/from-bsdata.js chaos-daemons), Wahapedia chaos-daemons

items.where: Chaos Daemons · Legion of Excess rule · Beguiling Aura
items.why: "… are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back": used when the unit declares a charge; the Fall Back is its condition (the same reading as Tyranids · Questing Tendrils above).
items.rule: "eligible to (declare a) charge in a turn in which they …" is used in the Charge phase
items.source: data.js FACTIONS chaos-daemons (a catalogue detachment, verify/from-bsdata.js chaos-daemons), Wahapedia chaos-daemons

items.where: Chaos Daemons · Legion of Excess rule · Seductive Gambit
items.why: The rule grants an ability: "Each time this unit ends a Charge move, you can declare it will perform a Seductive Gambit. If you do, until the end of the turn, … each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll …": declared at the end of a Charge move (your Charge phase), used in that turn's Fight phase. derive.js reads the granted ability ("have the following ability: **Seductive Gambit:** …") as nothing.
items.rule: a rule that grants an ability in its words ("… have the following ability: **Name:** text") is timed as that ability's text
items.source: data.js FACTIONS chaos-daemons (a catalogue detachment, verify/from-bsdata.js chaos-daemons), Wahapedia chaos-daemons
